title: The Courteous Dead of Hollowmere Tomb
theme: Crypt where polite undead debate who deserves burial honor
hook: A noble funeral procession stopped at Hollowmere when the coffin politely refused to enter. The family will pay for answers before mourners become scandal witnesses.
background: The tomb houses rival branches of one family. A forged lineage plaque has awakened the dead, who want the living to settle succession before the new body is admitted.

layout.notes: Symmetrical tomb layout with ritual chambers, dead ends, and sealed objective space.

rooms.name: Mourner's Descent
rooms.readAloud: Black ribbons trail down broad steps. The new coffin waits upright at the landing as if listening.
rooms.gmNotes: The coffin knocks once for yes and twice for no; it fears being buried with a lie.
rooms.treasure: A mourning pin set with dull jet.
rooms.secrets: A hidden seam behind the ribbon leads to the servant ossuary.
rooms.exits: Down to Room 2, seam to Room 4.

rooms.name: Hall of Seated Ancestors
rooms.readAloud: Stone chairs line the hall. Each chair holds a shrouded figure with a porcelain name mask.
rooms.gmNotes: The dead are formal and can be negotiated with if addressed by title.

inhabitants.name: Porcelain-Masked Ancestors
inhabitants.tactics: Block corridors, demand formal answers, call witnesses
inhabitants.morale: Stand down when the forgery is proven
inhabitants.wants: Correct names, proper burial, family truth
inhabitants.leverage: They respect old etiquette and written evidence

rooms.treasure: An ivory genealogy clasp from an empty chair.
rooms.secrets: One name mask has been swapped with a servant's mask.
rooms.exits: Stairs to Room 1, arch to Room 3, side arch to Room 4.

rooms.name: Flooded Offering Trench
rooms.readAloud: A shallow trench of dark water cuts across the floor. Coins glimmer beneath floating funeral flowers.
rooms.gmNotes: Taking coins without replacing them wakes a skeletal usher.

inhabitants.name: Skeletal Usher
inhabitants.tactics: Drive intruders into water, separate thieves from witnesses
inhabitants.morale: Returns to post if offerings are restored

rooms.treasure: Old funeral coins, safe to take only after the rite is repaired.
rooms.secrets: The trench hides a weighted plaque naming a disinherited heir.
rooms.exits: Arch to Room 2, lower stairs to Room 5.

rooms.name: Servant Ossuary
rooms.readAloud: Small bones are stacked with care, each bundle tied by a faded work ribbon.
rooms.gmNotes: A servant spirit knows the forged plaque was commissioned by the current heir.

inhabitants.name: Old Housekeeper Spirit
inhabitants.tactics: Hide in cold drafts, whisper names, shame liars
inhabitants.morale: Helps anyone who honors the servants
inhabitants.wants: Her people remembered in the family record
inhabitants.leverage: Add the servants to the funeral prayer

rooms.treasure: A ribbon ledger proving who served each branch.
rooms.secrets: The housekeeper watched the plaque being swapped.
rooms.exits: Side arch to Room 2, hidden seam to Room 1, lower stair to Room 6.

rooms.name: False Lineage Chapel
rooms.readAloud: A new marble plaque shines too brightly among older, smoke-stained names.
rooms.gmNotes: The plaque is trapped with falling stone letters if removed carelessly.
rooms.treasure: Silver inlay from the false plaque if removed intact.
rooms.secrets: The real plaque is hidden behind the chapel's funeral bell.
rooms.exits: Lower stairs to Room 3, bell door to Room 6.

rooms.name: The Unquiet Bier
rooms.readAloud: A stone bier waits beneath a cracked skylight. The old family founder sits beside it, perfectly patient.
rooms.gmNotes: The founder asks the party to name the rightful story, not merely the rightful heir.

inhabitants.name: Hollowmere Founder
inhabitants.tactics: Command ancestors, seal exits, force testimony
inhabitants.wants: The family lie ended before another burial

rooms.treasure: Founder's signet of legal authority and a family debt of gratitude.
rooms.secrets: The new corpse tried to confess the forgery before dying.

environmental.result: Cold air forms words on polished stone
Funeral flowers drift against the hidden plaque
The tomb doors politely lock for testimony
Porcelain masks turn toward a lie

complications.result: A living mourner enters and panics
An ancestor challenges the party's authority
A forged clue appears convincing at first glance
The usher mistakes someone for a tomb robber
A passage closes until an apology is spoken

gmNotes: Play the undead as formal, not automatically hostile.
The central problem is a forged family history.
The twist is that the new corpse wanted to confess.
A satisfying ending publicly corrects the family record.
